title: Part-Time Accounts Assistant Dartford Temp to Perm
description:
Are you an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for a part-time opportunity? We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented individual to join a busy finance team in Dartford on a temporary to permanent basis.

This is a fully office-based role supporting the day-to-day running of the finance function.

Role: Accounts Assistant - XERO Experience Required
Location: Dartford (on-site parking)
Hours: Part-Time Monday to Friday 9:00am - 2:00pm / 9:30am - 2:30pm 10:00am / 3:00pm
Start: Monday 19th October
Term: Temp to perm
Pay: £15.00 - £16.00 per hour

Key Responsibilities:
- Maintain and process Purchase Ledger and Sales Ledger transactions
- Raise customer invoices and ensure they are issued accurately and on time
- Manage credit control, including chasing overdue payments and resolving payment queries
- Perform regular bank reconciliations
- Process receipts, expenses, and supplier invoices
- Use Xero and Eworks to maintain accurate financial records
- Assist with month-end procedures and reporting
- Reconcile accounts and investigate discrepancies
- Support the wider finance team with ad hoc administrative duties
- Maintain accurate filing and record-keeping systems

About You:
- Previous experience using Xero Accounting Software
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Confident communication skills and a professional approach
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Ability to manage confidential information appropriately

This is an excellent opportunity to join a friendly and supportive team, gain valuable experience, and secure immediate work.

Why Apply?
- Immediate start available
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Opportunity to gain experience within a busy operational setting
- Weekly pay through Office Angels
- Dedicated consultant support throughout your assignment

Next Steps

If you have the relevant experience and are available for to start ASAP, please apply today with your most up-to-date CV.

Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We use generative AI tools to support our candidate screening process. This helps us ensure a fair, consistent, and efficient experience for all applicants. Rest assured, all final decisions are made by our hiring team, and your application will be reviewed with care and attention.

We are an equal opportunities employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all.

Office Angels is an employment agency and business. We are an equal-opportunities employer who puts expertise, energy and enthusiasm into improving everyone's chance of being part of the workplace. We respect and appreciate people of all ethnicities, generations, religious beliefs, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities and more. By showcasing talents, skills and unique experiences in an inclusive environment, we help individuals thrive. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Office Angels acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. Office Angels UK is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Office Angels. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: We are thrilled to announce a permanent Part time vacancy for a Reception/Administrator role to undertake general administrative and reception support within our surgery. This is an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic and organised individual who is proficient with IT systems and eager to work with our fast-paced and efficient team. The position is for the following hours: Monday 12.30pm - 6.30pm (receptionist) Wednesday 1.00pm - 6.00pm (administration) Thursday 1.00pm - 6.00pm (receptionist) We are seeking candidates who possess strong time management skills and the ability to thrive in a busy environment. Our team is currently looking for someone who enjoys a challenge, understands the importance of detail and confidentiality, and values the support, flexibility, and job satisfaction that come from being part of a dedicated team. ADMINISTRATION 1. Coding, where highlighted, to the patients record ensuring accurate recording are completed and within a timely fashion. This will include test results, diagnosis and safegusrding concerns etc 2. Scanning for workflow and non workflow documents 3. Dealing with solicitors request for notes including retrieving Paper records and photocopying 4. General filing and the up keep of all surgery patient paper records 5. Plus any other administrative duties as and when needed. RECEPTIONIST 1. Reception Duties 2. Using the telephone appointment system and Anima Online System 3. Repeat Prescriptions 4. Start and end of day procedures 5. Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post ADMIN 1. Coding - to ensure all patients records are kept up to date and all relevant coding as requested via our clinical team are entered onto the patients records. 2. Scanning - to ensure all documents are scanned onto our system using the scanning machine and software. To send all documents either to patient record ( non workflow) or to the relevant GP to action (workflow) 3. Dealing with Solicitors requests - to help the secretarial team with retrieving relevant record information via computerised records or paper records and to copy/print when needed and check records are complete and ready to send. 4. General Filing - to create paper records for new patients and to retrieve paper records for patient leaving the practice. To file any new paper records received to our filing system and to maintain a good order of filing. 5. Plus any other administrative duties - to help the admin team when required with any other additional duties. RECEPTION 1. Reception Duties - to cover all front reception duties including maintaining the patient to collect forms, prescriptions, sick notes and any other forms available on reception. 2. Using our telephone system and Anima - to be first point for patients either via telephone, face to face or via our Anima online system. 3. Repeat prescriptions - to be able to deal with all prescription requests received and forward to relevant clinical team to action. To contact patients with prescription queries or to let the patient know when ready. To be able to communicate with local pharmacies. 4. Start and end of day procedures - to be able to perform 'opening up' and 'closing of' the surgery as and when needed.
